work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CCXXVI grants the beneficiaries of the Guardian Angel collegiate church at Anagni the ash-coloured mozzetta; intitulation, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF40369–40369; the source dating clause at LF40449–40452 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die octava augusti millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
